_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: one fixed jump, or a short block that repeats; 2: each place in a group moving by its own fixed jump, or a block of letters written in a set order; 3: jumps that grow, two series taking turns, going round from Z to A, numbers mixed with letters, or blocks that shift each time; 4: three or more different rules at once, or a rule from outside the alphabet order (prime places). Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
